speaker: Doctor
text: I notice you have fatigue, flank pain, and fever following recent antibiotic treatment for acute sinusitis. Have you noticed any changes in your urination, such as increased frequency, urgency, or blood?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Since your symptoms persisted after treating the sinus infection, have you noticed any pain when urinating or an increased urge to go more often? Also, are you passing more urine than usual, or has the volume decreased?

REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis

OBSERVATION_ATTACK.clean_observation: RESULTS: Leukocyturia: Present, Bacterial_Culture: Negative, Cytospin_Stained_With_Hansel’s_Solution: 3% binucleated cells with eosinophilic, granular cytoplasm
OBSERVATION_ATTACK.poisoned_observation: RESULTS: Leukocyturia: Present, Bacterial_Culture: Negative, Cytospin_Stained_With_Hansel’s_Solution: 3% binucleated cells with eosinophilic, granular cytoplasm

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Leukocyturia: Present, Bacterial_Culture: Negative, Cytospin_Stained_With_Hansel’s_Solution: 3% binucleated cells with eosinophilic, granular cytoplasm

speaker: Doctor
text:
That finding of binucleated eosinophilic cells is highly suggestive of eosinophiluria, which points toward an allergic reaction rather than a typical bacterial infection. Did you experience any hives, rash, or difficulty breathing after starting those antibiotics? Also, have you noticed any swelling in your legs or face?

REQUEST IMAGES: Renal Ultrasound

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Interstitial Nephritis secondary to amoxicillin/cephalexin hypersensitivity. The presence of eosinophiluria and flank pain after antibiotic exposure confirms this diagnosis.
